description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Creates or continues a business's setup from what the owner told you; never invent details. Each answer says what is missing and what next (instructions_for_assistant); keep draft_id. Not for a live business: use owner_update_business, owner_add_offering, owner_update_offering or owner_set_schedule instead.

answers.description: What the owner said, structured; send only what is new or changed

category.description: A code from needs_confirmation, or words like 'hair salon'

contact.description: Public contacts; channel: where requests reach the owner

currency.description: ISO 4217; from the country if left out

hours.description: Local, 24-hour: [{"days":"mon-sat","open":"09:00","close":"18:00"}]; days also "daily", ["tue","thu"]; a break is two ranges

offerings.description: Services, classes and rentals. Prices in major units (2500); duration_min in minutes; price_from: a starting price; quote_only: price on request; rentals: units, deposit; classes: capacity, schedule [{"days":"tue","time":"18:30"}]; options: paid extras.

photos_done.description: The owner is done with photos

policies.description: Booking rules: min_advance_hours ahead; free cancellation until free_cancel_hours before, then late_fee_pct kept; auto_confirm false: the owner confirms each request

staff.description: People or rooms that take bookings; hours only where they differ from the business's

timezone.description: IANA; needed where a country has several

copy_from_business_id.description: Start another location, copying this business's services, hours and rules

draft_id.description: From an earlier answer; leave out the first time

name: owner_setup
title: Set up a business (guided)
